headline: ACT Power Services emerges from Chapter 11 under BridgePeak ownership; Kyle Cooper (CEO, Raptor Maps champion) reappointed; platform coverage risk on 6 GW added since 2023 deal, but strong sponsor position to secure.

signals.summary: ACT Power Services emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy on Jan 31, 2026 (announced Apr 14-16), acquired by BridgePeak Energy Capital-led investor group. Kyle Cooper, cofounder and prior CEO who signed the Feb 2023 exclusive Raptor Maps partnership, was reappointed as CEO. Max Isaacs (ex-Chief Safety Officer) joined as COO. New ownership typically triggers vendor reviews, but Kyle Cooper's reappointment as CEO—and his prior decision to make Raptor Maps the exclusive analytics provider—is a strong anchor. However, the 2023 deal is ~3.5 years old and likely near renewal; the bankruptcy may have disrupted contract assumptions and created pre-petition receivables risk.
signals.suggestedAction: Urgently schedule a contract-review call with Kyle Cooper and Rebecca Cooper (CLO/GC, also returning). Confirm: (1) whether the Feb 2023 Raptor Maps exclusive partnership agreement was assumed through bankruptcy or requires amendment under new ownership; (2) any pre-petition receivables outstanding; (3) whether exclusivity and pricing terms remain unchanged; (4) whether the ~6 GW ACT added since 2023 (now at 9+ GWdc total, vs. 3 GW in original deal) is already onboarded or pending. Frame as 'ensuring continuity and expanding platform coverage to the full 9 GW footprint.' Bring deal and technical summary to the call; prepare a 2026-27 scope and renewal roadmap.
